title: Healer Message Envelope v2
description: Common envelope wrapping every message exchanged between the Control Plane and an Agent over the WebSocket connection.

protocol_version.description: Contract version, e.g. "1.0" (the wire-level version negotiated at connect time — independent of this schema directory's v2 label).

message_id.description: Unique id for this message, used for logging/idempotency.

type.description: Message type, selects which payload schema applies.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp the message was created.

payload.description: Message-type-specific body; validated against the schema named for `type`.
